name: github-auto-switch
description: Browser extension that opens every GitHub page with the right account, by your rules.

scripts.test:e2e:dist: node scripts/build.mjs chromium && EXTENSION_DIR=dist/chromium node --test test/e2e.test.js
scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.sign:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted
